title: The Dynamic Informativeness of Scheduled News
eligible_reason: No DiD or event-study design. 'treated' flags options whose maturity spans the next scheduled earnings announcement; identification comes from the discontinuity in the option-implied-volatility term structure within firm-day (cusip x date FE). No unit adopts a treatment at a calendar date.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). Table 4: reghdfe BKM tpsig [mat* tpsigdrep tpsigdrep2], absorb(cusipdate), vce(cluster cusiprepdate date), where BKM = 2*log(implied variance) and tpsig = treated/tau. Table 5 adds cumulative up/down signal counts (forecast, recommendation, insider-trade revisions) interacted with tpsig; Figures 4-5 split by insider position and time to announcement. S&P 500 firms, OptionMetrics/CRSP/IBES/Compustat, daily.

specs.exclusion_reason: not a DiD: within firm-day cross-maturity comparison, no adoption timing
specs.treatment_var: tpsig (treated/tau; option expires after next EA)

data_files: Data/*.dta, *.csv (raw-input stubs of a few KB each; Trades_*.dta files are identical 17,939-byte files)
data_files_note: Readme: analysis files OptionsAcc.dta, Jumps.dta, AltMea.dta must be rebuilt from OptionMetrics, CRSP, Compustat, IBES and Thomson insider data via WRDS; none of them is shipped.
data_provenance_note: Only tiny placeholder/raw-structure files are shipped; the analysis datasets are absent.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe) plus MATLAB (CleanOptions.m) for option cleaning.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (Readme.pdf, Table4/Table5 do-files, logs). code_prescore 2 reflects the 'treated' variable name; it is an option-maturity indicator, not a policy treatment.
